feature_detection_desc: Checks CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy in seconds.
feature_report_desc: Finds missing or weak settings and shows exactly what to fix.
feature_score_desc: Get a 0 to 100 score based on modern best practices and detected risks.
form_firecrawl: Retry with Firecrawl if the direct fetch fails
history_subtitle: Your previous analyses, saved in this browser.
history_empty_body: Every site you audit will show up here with its score and level.
auth_subtitle: Access your analysis history and metrics.
auth_account_created: Account created. Check your email to confirm.
notfound_body: The address you're looking for moved or was never here.
error_body: Something went wrong on our end. Try again or go back home.
err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
err_firecrawl_not_configured: Firecrawl isn't configured on the server.
err_url_credentials: Credentials in the URL aren't allowed.
rule_ok_risk: No known risk with this configuration.
rule_csp_desc: Defines which content sources (scripts, styles, images, frames) the page may load.
rule_csp_missing_risk: Without a CSP, an attacker with XSS can run arbitrary scripts unrestricted.
rule_csp_unsafe_risk: Using 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval' or wildcards (*) drastically weakens XSS protection.
rule_csp_unsafe_rec: Remove 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval' and restrict sources using hashes or nonces.
rule_csp_ok_rec: Keep the policy and review new directives periodically.
rule_hsts_desc: Forces browsers to use HTTPS for every future connection to the domain.
rule_hsts_missing_risk: Allows downgrade and MITM attacks on the first connection over HTTP.
rule_hsts_short_risk: max-age={age} is under 6 months; browsers will forget the policy quickly.
rule_hsts_short_rec: Use at least max-age=31536000, ideally with includeSubDomains and preload.
rule_hsts_ok_rec: Consider adding preload and submitting the domain to hstspreload.org.
rule_xfo_desc: Prevents the page from being embedded in malicious iframes (clickjacking).
rule_xfo_missing_risk: An attacker can embed the site in an iframe and trick users into unwanted clicks.
rule_xfo_nonstandard_risk: Non-standard value; some browsers will ignore it.
rule_xcto_desc: Stops the browser from guessing (sniffing) the response MIME type.
rule_xcto_missing_risk: Allows MIME sniffing attacks that can turn content into something executable.
rule_xcto_invalid_risk: Any value other than 'nosniff' is invalid.
rule_rp_desc: Controls how much referrer information is sent when navigating to other sites.
rule_rp_missing_risk: Full URLs leak to external sites, potentially exposing tokens or sensitive data.
rule_rp_unsafe_risk: unsafe-url always sends the full referrer, even over HTTP.
rule_pp_desc: Restricts access to browser APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation, etc.).
rule_pp_missing_risk: Without restrictions, third-party scripts can request sensitive APIs.
rule_pp_ok_rec: Check that the directives cover at least camera, microphone and geolocation.
rule_coop_desc: Isolates the browsing context from cross-origin popups.
rule_coep_desc: Requires embedded resources to explicitly opt in to being loaded (CORP/CORS).
rule_coep_missing_risk: Without COEP, isolated APIs such as SharedArrayBuffer can't be used safely.
rule_corp_desc: Declares which origins may include this resource.
rule_corp_missing_risk: Other sites can include your resources in side-channel attacks.
rule_corp_weak_risk: cross-origin allows use from any site.
rule_server_desc: Identifies the web server. Revealing a version makes targeted attacks easier.
rule_server_version_risk: Exposes the server version, which helps an attacker look for specific exploits.
rule_server_version_rec: Hide the version or remove the header in the server or proxy configuration.
rule_server_present_risk: Ideally this header isn't sent at all.
rule_server_present_rec: Remove the Server header in the server configuration.
rule_xpb_desc: Reveals the backend technology (PHP, Express, ASP.NET, etc.).
rule_xpb_risk: Reveals the tech stack, making it easier to look up known vulnerabilities.
rule_xpb_rec: Remove the X-Powered-By header in the app or proxy.
